verses.text: <pb/><t>Na shiga cikin lambuna, budurwata, amaryata,</t> <t>Ina tattara mur da ƙaro.</t> <t>Ina shan zuma da kakinsa.</t> <t>Ina shan ruwan inabi da madara kuma. <pb/>Ƙaunatattuna, ku ci ku sha, har ku bugu da ƙauna!</t>

<t>Ina barci, amma zuciyata na a farke,</t> <t>Sai na ji ƙaunataccena yana ƙwanƙwasa ƙofa. <pb/>Buɗe mini in shigo, ƙaunatacciyata, budurwata, kurciyata,</t> <t>Wadda ba wanda zai kushe ki.</t> <t>Kaina ya jiƙe da raɓa,</t> <t>Gashina ya yi danshi da laimar ƙāsashi. <pb/></t>
<t>Na riga na tuɓe tufafina, in sāke sa su kuma?</t> <t>Na wanke ƙafafuna, in sāke ɓata su?</t>
<t>Ƙaunataccena ya janye hannunsa daga ƙofa,</t> <t>Zuciyata kuwa tana kansa.</t>
<t>Sai na tashi don in buɗe wa ƙaunataccena, ya shigo.</t> <t>Hannuna sharkaf da mur,</t> <t>Yatsuna suna ɗiga da mur sa'ad da na kama hannun ƙofar.</t>
<t>Na buɗe wa ƙaunataccena ƙofa, amma ya riga ya tafi!</t> <t>Na so in ji muryarsa ƙwarai!</t> <t>Na neme shi, amma ban same shi ba.</t> <t>Na yi kiransa, amma ba amsa. <pb/></t>
<t>Matsara masu kai da kawowa cikin birni suka same ni,</t> <t>Suka doke ni suka yi mini rauni.</t> <t>Matsaran da suke kan garu suka fige gyalena.</t>
<t>Ku yi mini alkawari ku matan Urushalima,</t> <t>Idan kun ga ƙaunataccena,</t> <t>Ku faɗa masa na yi suwu saboda ƙauna. <pb/></t>
<t>Ke mafi kyau cikin mata,</t> <t>Ki faɗi yadda ƙaunatacce naki yake.</t> <t>Wane abin sha'awa take gare shi,</t> <t>Har da za mu yi miki alkawari?</t>
<t>Ƙaunataccena kyakkyawa ne ƙaƙƙarfa kuma,</t> <t>Da ƙyar a sami ɗaya irinsa a cikin dubu goma.</t>
<t>Gashin kansa dogaye ne suna zarya,</t> <t>Baƙi wulik kamar jikin shaya.</t> <t>Kansa ya fi zinariya daraja.</t>
<t>Idanunsa kamar na kurciyoyi a bakin ƙorama,</t> <t>Waɗanda suka yi wanka da madara suna tsaye a bakin rafi.</t>
<t>Kumatunsa kyawawa ne kamar lambu,</t> <t>Wanda yake cike da tsire-tsire da kayan yaji.</t> <t>Leɓunansa kamar furen bi-rana ne, suna bulbulo da mur.</t>
<t>Hannuwansa kyawawa ne,</t> <t>Saye da ƙawanen da aka yi musu ado da duwatsu masu daraja.</t> <t>Ƙugu nasa sumul sumul ne kamar hauren giwa da aka manne da yakutu.</t>
<t>Cinyoyinsa kamar ginshiƙan da aka yi da dutsen alabasta,</t> <t>Aka kafa su a cikin kwasfar zinariya.</t> <t>Kamanninsa kamar Dutsen Lebanon ne,</t> <t>Da itatuwan al'ul ɗinsa mafi kyau.</t>
<t>Bakinsa yana da daɗin sumbata,</t> <t>Kome nasa yana faranta mini rai.</t> <t>Matan Urushalima, yadda ƙaunataccena yake ke nan.</t>
